verdict.rationale: Notion's own Custom Agents are described as keeping work moving 24/7, and the Agent APIs let users manage their status and credit limits, which points to first-party autonomous background agents. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though. Webhooks and internal-connection tokens are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented triggers or recurring schedules for agents, details on how background runs are configured and execute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Find the Custom Agents your token can access, track their usage, and manage their status and credit limits.
